svg.title: Fermi sea: electrons forced into high momentum states
svg.desc: A ladder of momentum states. Low-density case: only the bottom rungs occupied. High-density case: all rungs up to the Fermi momentum occupied, with electrons forced into high-momentum states by the Pauli exclusion principle.
svg.text: Why squeezed electrons must have high momentum
Pauli: at most 2 electrons per momentum state (one per spin)
many electrons, forced up to p_F
Even at T = 0, all states up to p_F are occupied — these electrons carry momentum and exert pressure
